snippet.title: Kukulu 3D mobile game trailer
snippet.description:
Kukulu is a 3D mobile runner game that is about a chicken who is making a run for her life. It is an epic adventure full of magical gameplay and exciting story.

You can download the game from google play using this link.
- https://play.google.com/store/apps/details? 
   id=com.qenetech.kukulu
